## About this project

This is a personal data project by Isfar Baset: a "year in review" built from my own exported viewing history, in the style of the end-of-year recaps many apps publish.

**This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Netflix, Inc.** It never asks for your account, password, or any personal information, and it has no login of any kind.

### How It Works

1. **Export your own viewing history** from your streaming account's privacy settings
2. **Run the processing script** from the GitHub repo on your own computer
3. **View your personalized recap**, generated locally

### Getting Your Data

Most streaming services, Netflix included, let you request a copy of your personal data from the privacy section of your account settings. Request the viewing activity export, then place `ViewingActivity.csv` in the `data/` folder of your local copy of the repo. Full steps are in the [README on GitHub](https://github.com/isfarbaset/netflix-recap).

### Privacy

- All data processing happens locally on your machine
- No data is sent to any external servers
- Your viewing history stays private

### Built With

- **Python** - Data processing and analysis
- **Quarto** - Static site generation
- **GitHub Pages** - Free hosting

### Source Code

This project is open source. Feel free to fork it and create your own Recap!

[source code →](https://github.com/isfarbaset/netflix-recap){.source-link}
